world_symbols:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production WORLD MAP SYMBOL TILE atlas.
Reference image 1: Fire Emblem Gaiden WORLD MAP. Match its small symbolic scale and economy: settlements are tiny map symbols; a whole fort is 1–2 tiles, temples are simple roof-and-columns symbols, not close-up illustrations. Reference image 2: the user-approved B color/style direction. KEEP that soft muted olive, ash gray/lilac, dusty plum/brown, dull brass palette. Do NOT copy the neon original colors.
Make exactly SIXTEEN simple complete isolated world-map symbols in a regular 4x4 grid with wide transparent margins. Genuine transparent background. No labels, numbers, grid lines or checkerboard.
VERY IMPORTANT: these are conceived at 16x16 native pixels for small symbols and 32x16 or 32x32 for bigger symbols, then enlarged. Only 2–3 flat tones per material, few structural lines, no bricks, leaf textures, ornamental floor, decorative flags, windows full of detail, glow, gradients or modern miniature rendering. Almost diagrammatically economical like the world landmarks of Gaiden. Do not create a village diorama or single building battle-map asset.
Exact reading order:
Row1: a tiny village symbol consisting of ONE simple plum-roof house; the same tiny one-house village with two simple white snow strips on roof; a SMALL walled harbor/city symbol with one short plain wooden dock, no water background; a low compact two-part wall/fort gate symbol, two tiny square towers.
Row2: a square castle/capital symbol with 3 tiny plum roof towers, complete outline, 2x2 native tiles; a very simple original temple symbol, triangular pale roof and 3 short stone columns, tiny dull sun circle on pediment, 2x1 tiles; one narrow cylindrical sun relay tower with a little dull brass disk, 1x2 tiles; one small gray rock-and-dark-cave-mouth symbol with NO timber tracks or surrounding stones, 1 tile.
Row3: one narrow plain lighthouse symbol on a small gray base, 1x2 tiles; simple little observatory symbol, low stone base and tiny brass ring, 2x1 tiles; a tiny sand-city symbol with two plain flat roof silhouettes and little plum awning, 2x1 tiles; tiny stockade/gate symbol, simple gray front wall and black central arch, 2x1 tiles.
Row4: simple two-small-tent supply camp symbol, 1 tile; tiny one-mast sailboat symbol, white sail, brown hull, 1 tile; small dark prison ship symbol, ONE plum sail, simple hull, 2x1 tiles; a small plain library/temple symbol with a rectangular plum roof and short gray columns, 2x1 tiles.
Camera the same overhead/short-front WORLD MAP language as Gaiden, no diamond isometric perspective. Whole silhouettes, no rectangular ground pads, no trees beside landmarks, no realistic object shadows, no neighboring spill. All symbols are very spare, subdued and readable when scaled to 16px per tile. No characters, crosses, ornate cathedrals, weapon art or modern buildings.
